meta.description: The bibliography behind JOURNEYWAYS: gender theory, institutional data, arts-based research, critical ethnography, thematic analysis, game studies, co-creation, and pedagogy. The works that shaped a master's research project at the UBC Institute for Gender, Race, Sexuality and Social Justice.

hero.title: What I’ve been reading.
hero.tagline: The bibliography behind the project, grouped thematically.
hero.lead: These works shaped how JOURNEYWAYS was framed and designed. Some are old enough to be foundational; others are recent and feel like conversations still in progress. This is the load-bearing structure behind the project’s first phase.
